plain.li: With the stores this low, {OTHER_nameDef} wants "{WISH}"?
Can we fix the leaks in the roof before anyone starts on "{WISH}"?
I'm not saying no. I'm saying food and walls come first.
[poor] We can't pay for it. We're down to rice and whatever the hunters bring in.
[winter] It's the middle of winter. Every hand on "{WISH}" is one less hand cutting firewood.
[afterraid] We were patching wounds half the night, and now "{WISH}" comes first?
[trait:Ascetic] We've managed without it this long. I don't see what's changed.
[trait:Ascetic] I sleep on a bedroll and eat what I'm given. I don't see why we need more.
[trait:Jealous] I asked the council for something last month and heard nothing. {OTHER_nameDef} asks, and we all sit down to discuss it.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] That's days of work for one person's comfort, with fields to sow and walls to finish.

warm.li: I'm sorry, {OTHER_nameDef}. Some of us are still sleeping on the floor.
Could it wait until we all have a bed and a hot meal?
I'd say yes in a better season, {OTHER_nameDef}. Not this one.

blunt.li: No. There are bigger problems than this.
{OTHER_nameDef} wants "{WISH}". I want a roof that doesn't leak. Mine comes first.
Give {OTHER_nameDef} "{WISH}" and the rest of us will be lining up tomorrow.

cheerful.li: I like it, I really do! Can we come back to it once the walls are up?

gloomy.li: {WISH}, now. As if we didn't have enough to look after.
We'll spend everything we have on it, and the raiders will carry it off in the end.

cold.li: I object. The materials for "{WISH}" are needed elsewhere.
{OTHER_nameDef}'s comfort is not a colony priority.
